specs.title: Order with a card, from the basket to the order history

steps.title: 1. Add product A two times and product B one time from the product list
2. Open the basket
3. Click Checkout, select the saved address and continue
4. Select One Day Delivery and continue
5. Redeem the coupon of the current month
6. Select the saved card and continue
7. Click Place your order and pay
8. Read the order summary on the confirmation page
9. Read the basket counter and open the basket
10. Open the order history from the account menu

specs.title: Pay an order with the wallet: too little money, then exactly the order total

steps.title: 1. Open the basket, click Checkout, select the saved address and continue
2. Select Standard Delivery and continue
3. Read the wallet pay button
4. Open the order history from the account menu
5. Open the digital wallet from the account menu
Precondition: add money to the wallet so that it holds the order total
6. Go to the payment step again with Standard Delivery
7. Click the wallet pay button
8. Click Place your order and pay
9. Open the digital wallet from the account menu
10. Open the order history from the account menu
